structured_output.title: Certificate commonName IP handling may change SAN output
structured_output.content: The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and the certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] CRD, which this fix covers. The change only matters if a Certificate sets an IP address in its commonName field. The summary doesn't show spec contents, so that is unknown. Inspect each Certificate for an IP in commonName. After upgrade, that IP moves from the DNS subjectAlternativeName list to ipAddresses, so check that any clients or validators relying on the old DNS SAN still work.
